landing.title: About Us
landing.description: Learn about the story behind Hannah Thai Spa — founded by Nutcha, a Thai entrepreneur from north-east Thailand, bringing authentic Thai wellness to Castle Bromwich and the Midlands.

section.title: Authentic Thai Wellness, Rooted in Tradition
section.paragraph1: Hannah Thai Spa was founded by Nutcha, a Thai entrepreneur from the north-east of Thailand who has called the Midlands home for over 20 years. With a deep respect for traditional Thai healing and a passion for sharing it with others, Nutcha has built a family of spa businesses across the Midlands and back home in Koh Samui, Thailand.
section.paragraph2: The Castle Bromwich spa is named after her daughter Hannah, who manages the day-to-day running of the business. Between them, they bring together years of experience, genuine Thai expertise, and a shared commitment to making every guest feel properly cared for.
section.paragraph3: Every treatment at Hannah Thai Spa is delivered by Thai therapists trained in traditional technique — not a simplified version of it. From the moment you arrive at Castle Bromwich Hall to the moment you leave, the aim is always the same: to leave you feeling genuinely restored.
section.paragraph4: Whether you're local to Birmingham or visiting the hotel, you're welcome here. We've made it our business to bring a little piece of Thailand to the heart of the Midlands — and we hope you feel that from the very first visit.
section.quoteText: I've spent over 20 years sharing Thai wellness with people here in the UK. It's not just what we do — it's who we are.
